subject: Console snapshot + stepdown playbook for high-cost call chains
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-10-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Console snapshot + stepdown playbook for high-cost call chains

Hey team,

Quick context: ACME reported a sustained uptick in per-call costs this morning for a small set of chat flows. Their sample traces (attached) show unusually long downstream calls and repeated model fallbacks. This is starting to hit their committed spend and they want a clear remediation/playbook we can run from Console when we detect the pattern.

Ask: can we draft an operational playbook + a Console snapshot view that does the following:
- Surface the top 5 call chains by incremental token cost over the last 30m and 6h
- Show latency distribution per hop (ingress -> model selection -> adapter -> backend) with p50/p95/p99
- Provide one-click actions: pin to cheaper model variant, toggle aggressive caching, or enable temporary rate-stepdown for the tenant
- Prepopulated checklist for CS on what to tell customer (expected impact, rollback)

I attached a representative trace + SLO coverage matrix. Two constraints: we want this to be operable by CS (non-CLI) and to avoid heavy query loads on the metrics pipeline. Thoughts on feasibility and a rough ETA?

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Product Manager, Console & Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Console snapshot + stepdown playbook for high-cost call chains

On Mon, Oct 8, 2028 at 09:12 Soojin Lee wrote:
> Quick context: ACME reported a sustained uptick in per-call costs this morning...

This is the right type of product ask — operational and self-serve. A few implementation notes from my side:

1) Snapshot view: we can reuse the existing per-route summary tiles but add a "cost delta" column (30m vs 6h baseline). That avoids a heavy new query.
2) Call chain breakdown: we'll need a lightweight aggregation from traces backfilled into the metrics store. If we precompute a 5-min rolling index for top call-chains (similar to how we keep hot-model hotness), the Console can read the index and only fetch detailed traces on demand.
3) One-click actions: the UX is straightforward. Backend safety: any auto-change (pin/stepdown) must create an audit event and require a second confirmation from a privileged role.

Proposed next steps:
- Product: finalize the stepdown surface & wording (Soojin) — 3 business days
- Engineering: spike on 5-min rolling index and cost-delta metric — 5 business days (Karthik)
- CS/Support: draft script and rollback wording — 2 business days (I'll own)

I added small comments on the sample trace (attached) where I think automatic caching could have helped.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
SRE Lead, Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-10T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Console snapshot + stepdown playbook for high-cost call chains

Thanks for the clear ask. A couple of engineering constraints and a rough timeline: 

- Indexing approach: building a 5-min rolling hot-callchain index is feasible but needs a small pipeline job (Spark/Beam) to aggregate trace keys + token delta. We'll need 2 sprints (4 weeks) to deliver a hardened pipeline + a read API with TTL.
- Lightweight detail fetch: avoid fetching full traces for the Console list view; instead return summary rows and allow "drill" to fetch full trace for selected chain (this keeps DB load low).
- Stepdown safety: we must gate stepdown actions behind an org-scoped feature flag and role check (ops-only by default). The actual stepdown will be executed through our routing layer (policy override) and must propagate to the model router within 30s. I'll need to coordinate with routing infra (ticket INF-4823).

ETA (realistic): proof-of-concept in 2 weeks, alpha behind FF in 6 weeks, GA in 12 weeks (includes CS playbook + docs). If we need a faster interim, we can ship a read-only snapshot (UI + drill) in 10 business days that surfaces the same cost-delta numbers from an ad-hoc job.

I'll scope tasks and post a short runbook in the INF-4823 ticket.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this looks great and aligns with what we need. A couple quick asks from ACME:
- Can the read-only snapshot be enabled for our org as an interim while you build the stepdown? It will let our ops team triage and reduce noisy support tickets.
- If stepdown is ops-only, can you add a temporary delegated role so our SRE can trigger pinned-model changes with audit logging? We'll sign an agreement for constrained escalation rights.

Also: attaching a short note from our side on which call-chains are most business-sensitive. Happy to jump on a quick 30m to walk through the trace if that's helpful.

Best,
Ryan

Head of Platform Engineering, Acme ML
